description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single-target ranged hybrid attacks (0.90 or 3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking] to the user depending on entry damage, grants [Damage Cap +10000], Radiant Rising Headbutt, and Crystal Mode to the user
Crystal Mode: Earth/Lightning Ability Boost, Dualcast Earth/Lightning, Zero Hone Cost to Earth/Lightning Abilities & 25% DEF/RES Pierce
Crystal Force I/II: 6 single-target Earth/Lightning/NE ranged physical attacks (2.00 or 6.60 each) capped at 19999, Instant Cast, grants [Instant Cast 1] to all allies, grants [Damage Cap +10000 1], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 1], and [200% ATB 1] to the user
Radiant Rising Headbutt: After using an Earth or Lightning ability, grants [Soul Break Gauge +250] to the user (max 1 chase)
